label: Focus the destination after opening links
Mark the last link opened (subtle dotted outline on the source page)
Open a link in the source pane: hold exactly the selected modifiers while left-clicking. Select none to disable. Default: Alt/Option + Shift.

Other modifier combinations keep their normal behavior. Custom combinations replace the browser action only for eligible links in a linked source pane. Desktop or accessibility shortcuts may intercept a combination before Zen receives it.
